limits: JavaExecutionSamples are not elapsedtime or totalCPUshares. Inclusivecategories overlap; disjointscopes partition Java samples.
Allocationweights estimatechurn, notlive/retainedheap. GCsumOfPauses excludesdiagnosticheapdumpstop time.
Nativeallocator/free CPUsharesareseparate in native-cpu-shares.json. No full-eventJSONexportwasretained.

native_CPU_allocator_shares.scope: CPU sample shares with explicit native allocator/deallocator frames. These do not measure allocated bytes or retainedheap. Inclusiveallocation/free can overlap; union is disjointfromits complement. GC/JIT/ordinaryJavaallocationwithout explicitnativeframes is notclassified asmalloc/free.

CPU_scope_definition.disjoint: Observercallee-frames only before LoopConsumerObservation boundary(c5,c2,local savedapplication,other); globalcallerreplay is not misclassified as observerinternalwork; loopgate remainder; outside-loopC5; outside-loopC2; currentdelivery;savedreplay;statement;call;legacy;other
CPU_scope_definition.pipeline_inclusive_note: Inclusive categories overlap; never add percentages. Disjoint categories form a partition of JavaExecutionSamples.
CPU_scope_definition.baseline_note: Legacy anchors are distinct. No matching bidi frame is not proof of no work.
CPU_scope_definition.native_note: JFR JavaExecutionSamples do not measure native malloc/free shares; those are reported separately from async CPUcollapsed stacks.
